info.title: OrcheSphere API
info.description: Resource-bound company API. The initial release exposes saved workspaces, connections, portals, tasks and identity-verification jobs. Provider business-record reads/writes are not implemented. OAuth issuer remains https://orchesphere.ai. Backend/native clients only; no client secret, API key, client_credentials or browser CORS contract.

get.description: Find the company workspaces available to the consenting identity and obtain the workspace IDs needed by every company-scoped operation. Current active company assignments; verified global authority may see all company workspaces. No query parameters are accepted. OAuth scopes never grant company rights.

post.description: Queue a durable, read-only provider identity check for a saved connection, or return the existing submission for the same requester and idempotency key. Provider verify permission, implemented identity adapter and current entitlement/quota. Requires Idempotency-Key; replay with the same workspace/requester/key and connection returns the existing job, possibly already terminal. A different connection conflicts. No query parameters are accepted. OAuth scopes never grant company rights.

OAuth2.description: Registered public application; Authorization Code with S256 PKCE. Supply resource=https://api.orchesphere.ai at authorization, token exchange and refresh. Token scope and current user authority both apply.

scopes.orchesphere.read: Read only the current user’s permitted company data. Required for every operation.
scopes.orchesphere.jobs: Create/update authorized tasks and queue/cancel permitted identity-verification jobs.
scopes.orchesphere.manage: Configure permitted connections; service-grant changes still require the designated access administrator.
scopes.offline_access: Receive rotating refresh tokens, bounded by the grant lifetime. Adds no company permission.

code.description: Machine-readable failure identifier. Gateway and application codes share this envelope but are not always identical; branch on HTTP status and the documented code.

message.description: Safe explanation of the failure and possible recovery. Do not parse this human-readable text as a stable identifier.

error.description: Failure details. A failure after a submitted write does not prove that nothing was saved.

Error.description: An API or gateway failure. HTTP status and the machine code identify the recovery path; messages are safe explanations for the caller.

limit.description: Maximum number of items returned by this operation: 100 for jobs and 200 for other lists.

returned.description: Number of items actually present in this response after current access filtering.

mayHaveMore.description: True when the available list reaches the limit. This conservative flag is not proof of additional records; v1 has no cursor or next-page parameter.

Page.description: Bounds for one returned collection. This is not cursor pagination and does not expose a total count.

id.description: OrcheSphere workspace identifier. Use this value as workspaceId in subsequent requests; it is not a provider account ID.

Workspace.description: A company workspace that the current identity may access.

accountId.description: Saved NetSuite account identifier associated with the connection context.

environment.description: Saved provider environment label associated with this context.

roleId.description: Saved NetSuite role identifier, when available. It does not itself prove which business-record operations are enabled.

roleName.description: Saved NetSuite role display name, when available.

ProviderContext.description: Optional saved provider identity context. Currently projected for NetSuite; fields describe recorded evidence, not a new provider permission grant.

id.description: OrcheSphere connection identifier. Use it for verification only when this is a worker-managed connection with permitted verification access.

version.description: Saved configuration version. A settings change increments it so queued work can detect an outdated connection.

provider.description: Provider identifier from the OrcheSphere directory, such as netsuite or pipe17. Directory inclusion does not prove an implemented adapter.

name.description: Provider display name from the directory.

environment.description: Connection environment. Production and sandbox have separate saved settings and access rules.

expectedAccountId.description: Saved provider account identifier that verification is expected to match.

expectedCompanyName.description: Saved company or account label used by the provider identity check.

authMode.description: Saved authentication method. secrets_manager and agentcore use approved references; browser_session uses a separately authorized managed browser. managed_admin is an externally managed read-only projection and cannot be submitted to configureConnection.

hasCredential.description: Whether a credential reference or external authorization identifier is recorded. This does not confirm valid credentials or a successful provider read.

state.description: Recorded connection evidence: configured means settings are saved; data_read_verified means a supported identity read succeeded. Other values describe required authentication/permission, provider availability, identity mismatch, missing adapter or pending disconnection. Check timestamps and current errors before treating older evidence as current.

actualAccountId.description: Provider account identifier from recorded successful evidence, or null when no such evidence is recorded for these settings.

actualCompanyName.description: Provider company or account label from recorded successful evidence, or null when unavailable.

lastCheckedAt.description: Time of the recorded connection verification check, or null. This is evidence timing, not a promise of continuous monitoring.

lastReadAt.description: Time of the last recorded successful identity read, or null. A later credential or verification error can supersede this evidence.

lastRenewedAt.description: Time of the last recorded successful credential renewal, or null; it does not establish unattended renewal reliability.

credentialCheckedAt.description: Time of the recorded credential maintenance check, or null. This is separate from an identity-read check.

credentialErrorCode.description: Machine code for the recorded credential maintenance problem, or null when no such problem is recorded.

credentialError.description: Safe explanation of the recorded credential maintenance problem, or null.

errorCode.description: Machine code for the recorded connection verification problem, or null.

error.description: Safe explanation of the recorded connection verification problem, or null.

allowedActions.description: Current effective OrcheSphere service rights when supplied by a connection list. These control saved configuration and verification work, not provider business-record read/write roles.

providerContext.description: Optional provider-specific context retained from the saved connection; currently NetSuite account and role labels.

managedExternally.description: True for an authorization managed in another Platformz service rather than by the OrcheSphere integration worker.

managedBy.description: Display name of the service that owns an externally managed authorization.

manageUrl.description: Management page for an externally managed authorization. It is not a provider API endpoint.

note.description: Additional explanation of the connection projection and its current operational limitations.

Connection.description: Saved connection settings and recorded identity evidence. Optional fields may be omitted, particularly for externally managed projections; no provider secret or credential reference is returned.

workerState.description: online when a worker heartbeat falls within the accepted recent window; otherwise not_verified. A heartbeat does not prove that this company has completed a job.

lastHeartbeat.description: Latest heartbeat within the accepted recent window, or null when no recent heartbeat is recorded. It is not the timestamp of this company's last job.

persistence.description: Storage backing saved jobs and results. The current implementation reports PostgreSQL.

unattendedVerified.description: Currently always false. Renewal, restart and recovery evidence has not established verified unattended operation.

Runtime.description: Recorded worker and persistence evidence accompanying the connection list. This does not certify successful unattended operation.

id.description: OrcheSphere portal identifier. Use it as portalId when creating a task in this work area.

workspaceId.description: Company workspace that owns this portal.

slug.description: Saved URL-friendly portal label; use id, not this slug, in API request fields.

description.description: Saved explanation of the portal's purpose; may be empty.

role.description: Current caller's effective portal role: admin, operator or viewer.

canManage.description: Whether the caller has portal administrator authority. Portal-management operations are not exposed by REST v1.

canCreateTask.description: Whether the effective portal role allows task creation. The API token must also include orchesphere.jobs.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this portal record was created.

Portal.description: An accessible work area within a company. Its role and capability fields describe the current caller.

id.description: OrcheSphere task identifier. Use it as taskId to update this record.

workspaceId.description: Company workspace that owns this task.

portalId.description: Parent portal identifier; company and portal access still apply to task access.

description.description: Saved task instructions or context; may be empty. This is not an executable provider command.

status.description: Saved work-tracking state: todo, in_progress, blocked, review, done or cancelled. This does not report an integration worker or provider result.

assigneeEmail.description: Assigned eligible portal member email, or null when unassigned. REST updates do not support reassignment.

createdBy.description: Email identity recorded as the task creator.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this task record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this task record was last updated.

role.description: Current caller's effective task role. A reviewer may change status only; viewer access does not allow edits.

canEdit.description: Whether the caller has any task editing authority. Reviewers still cannot edit title or description; required OAuth scopes also apply.

canManage.description: Whether the caller has task administrator authority. This does not add management operations to REST v1.

Task.description: Saved requested work in a portal. A task status is maintained work tracking, not evidence that a provider operation ran.

accountId.description: Provider account identifier observed by the identity adapter.

companyName.description: Provider company name or account label observed by the identity adapter; interpret it using identityLabelKind.

observedAt.description: Timestamp when this successful identity result was recorded.

identityLabelKind.description: Whether companyName represents a company_name or a provider account_label.

credentialRenewedAt.description: Credential renewal timestamp reported during this successful check, or null if no renewal was recorded.

VerificationResult.description: Recorded output of a successful supported provider identity check. It contains identity evidence only, not orders, payments or other business records.

id.description: Saved OrcheSphere job identifier. Use it to poll getJob or request cancellation.

connectionId.description: Saved connection whose identity this job checks.

provider.description: Provider identifier associated with the job.

environment.description: Connection environment when supplied by the returned projection; it can be omitted from the initial queue response.

operation.description: Requested worker operation. REST v1 supports verify only.

status.description: Recorded worker state: queued awaits execution; running is claimed; retry_wait awaits a bounded retry; blocked needs attention; succeeded, failed and cancelled are terminal outcomes. Read result and error fields for the recorded outcome.

attempts.description: Number of recorded worker execution attempts; a newly queued job starts at zero.

createdBy.description: Email identity recorded as the verification requester.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the saved job was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when the saved job state was last updated.

finishedAt.description: Recorded job finish timestamp, or null when no finish time is recorded.

result.description: Recorded identity-verification output when available, otherwise null. The presence of a job ID is not successful evidence.

errorCode.description: Recorded worker error code, or null. Job failures are returned as saved state in a successful getJob response, not necessarily as an HTTP error.

error.description: Safe explanation of the recorded worker problem, or null.

canCancel.description: Caller cancellation authority when the list projection supplies it. Terminal jobs remain unchanged by cancellation, and the server rechecks current authority.

canResume.description: Whether the signed-in product can offer resumption when this optional projection is supplied. REST v1 has no resume operation.

resumeBlockedReason.description: Explanation of why resumption is unavailable when the optional projection supplies it, otherwise null.

Job.description: A saved identity-verification job. Optional capability fields are included in list projections when available and must not be assumed on every job response.

portalId.description: Existing portal ID returned by listPortals in this workspace. Creating a portal is outside REST v1.

title.description: Task title, trimmed before saving; must retain at least two characters after trimming.

description.description: Optional task instructions, trimmed before saving. Omit for an empty description.

assigneeEmail.description: Optional email of an eligible active member of this portal. Explicit assignment requires the designated access administrator; omission creates an unassigned task. Normalized to lowercase.

CreateTask.description: Fields for saving new requested work in an existing accessible portal.

title.description: Replacement task title, trimmed before saving. Requires task admin or contributor authority.

description.description: Replacement instructions, trimmed before saving. An empty string clears the description; omission keeps it. Requires task admin or contributor authority.

status.description: Replacement work-tracking state. Task reviewers may update this field only; this does not execute or cancel a provider operation.

UpdateTask.description: Fields to replace on an accessible task. Supply at least one field; omitted fields retain their saved values.

expectedAccountId.description: Exact expected provider account identifier, trimmed before saving and checked by the supported identity adapter.

expectedCompanyName.description: Expected company name or account label, trimmed before saving and evaluated by the provider's identity rules.

authMode.description: Authentication method supported by this catalog provider. secrets_manager and agentcore require an approved reference to use saved credentials; browser_session requires owner authority and a separate protected sign-in. Saving the mode alone does not authorize the provider.

credentialRef.description: A company-scoped credential reference, never a provider secret. Omit to retain an existing reference with unchanged authMode; empty string clears it. Browser mode forbids a reference.

ConfigureConnection.description: Expected identity and authentication settings for one provider/environment in a company. Raw provider secrets must never be submitted here.

email.description: Existing active or invited member email in this workspace, normalized to lowercase. The service rule does not activate an invitation.

actions.description: Exact replacement rights, not additions to the current list. Nonempty actions require read. jobs_cancel_all requires jobs_read_all. Empty array denies access. Viewer members may receive read-only actions only.

ServicePermissions.description: Replacement rights for an existing company member at the provider/environment in the request path. This does not create membership or set provider-side API roles.

Empty.description: Optional empty JSON object for verification and cancellation. Omit the body or send {}; additional fields are rejected.

ok.description: Always true for a successful response. Cancellation can acknowledge an already-terminal job without changing it.

Ok.description: Acknowledgment that the requested saved-state operation was accepted. Read the affected resource to inspect its resulting state.

ok.description: Always true after the task save succeeds.

workspaceId.description: Company workspace in which this task was saved.

task.description: Saved task record after the accepted change.

TaskResponse.description: Saved task returned after creation or update, with current caller capabilities.

job.description: Current saved job. A 202 submission can return an existing job in any recorded state when its idempotency key is replayed.

JobResponse.description: Saved verification job returned by getJob or queueing/replaying verification.

connection.description: Saved connection settings and recorded evidence after the operation; this response does not by itself prove live provider access.

reused.description: Present and true when identical existing settings were reused without resetting evidence. Omitted when a configuration was inserted or changed.

ConnectionResponse.description: Connection record returned after saving or reusing identical settings.

workspaces.description: Current company assignments visible to this identity; may be empty.

page.description: Returned item count and conservative truncation indicator.

WorkspaceList.description: Bounded list of currently accessible company workspaces.

connections.description: Saved connections with current read permission, including eligible externally managed read-only projections; may be empty.

page.description: Returned item count and conservative truncation indicator.

runtime.description: Recent worker-heartbeat and persistence evidence. It does not certify provider access or uninterrupted operation.

ConnectionList.description: Bounded list of saved connections visible under current company and service rights, plus worker evidence.

portals.description: Portals permitted by current company and portal authority; may be empty.

page.description: Returned item count and conservative truncation indicator.

PortalList.description: Bounded list of accessible saved company work areas.

tasks.description: Tasks visible through current company, portal and task authority; may be empty.

page.description: Returned item count and conservative truncation indicator.

TaskList.description: Bounded list of saved requested work visible to the caller.

jobs.description: Saved verification jobs visible to the requester or a caller with company job-read authority; may be empty.

page.description: Returned item count and conservative truncation indicator. This is not a total historical job count.

JobList.description: At most the latest 100 visible verification jobs, ordered newest first.
